thailand.name: Thailand
thailand.description: From glittering temples in Bangkok to paradise beaches in Phuket and Krabi, Thailand offers an unforgettable blend of culture, adventure, and relaxation.

malaysia.name: Malaysia
malaysia.description: A melting pot of cultures offering iconic city skylines, lush rainforests, pristine beaches, and a food paradise that rivals any destination in Southeast Asia.

maldives.name: Maldives
maldives.description: The ultimate luxury escape — overwater bungalows, the clearest blue waters on earth, vibrant coral reefs, and sunsets that will take your breath away.

bali.name: Bali
bali.description: Ancient temples, emerald rice terraces, world-class surf, and a spiritual energy unlike anywhere else — Bali is a destination that calls you back again and again.
